reserves.name: ZAR fiat reserves
reserves.issuerOrObligor: Old Mutual Wealth Trust Company (JHB) and Standard Bank of South Africa

sources.label: Kempen ZARP agreed-upon procedures report - September 1, 2026 (published with the site filename suffix for a signed draft)

reserveReview.rationale: Kempen Audit's ISRS 4400 (Revised) agreed-upon procedures report dated September 1, 2026 (the PDF that ZARP's transparency page links carries the filename suffix for a signed draft) covers ZARP balances on August 31, 2026. Procedure 2 verifies R89,062,624 in the Old Mutual Wealth Trust Company JHB account (cash: 31 August 2026 bank statement) and R2,923,773 in ZARP's Standard Bank accounts, while procedure 3 verifies the on-chain contract balances across Ethereum, Solana, Base, and Polygon against the 1 September 2026 blockchain snapshot. The attached management reserve report states 84,653,279.03 ZARP in circulation and R91,986,396.84 of cash and equivalents; the verified account components total R91,986,397 and the verified supply total of 84,653,279 agrees with the stated circulation, so this report's components and management total reconcile where the prior report left a R311,059.97 variance. The verified reserve balances therefore exceed the stated circulating liability. Kempen expressly states that an agreed-upon procedures engagement is not an assurance engagement and gives no opinion. The complete curated composition remains 100% ZAR fiat reserves.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Kempen Audit ISRS 4400 (Revised) agreed-upon procedures report on ZARP's August 31, 2026 reserve and supply balances
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The report verifies rand balances in the Old Mutual Wealth trust account and Standard Bank accounts, but does not provide a reserve-asset subcategory or establish statutory bankruptcy remoteness and rehypothecation terms.

nonLinkDispositions.rationale: ZAR trust-company and bank cash are external fiat reserves, not tracked stablecoin dependencies.

providers.name: The Standard Bank of South Africa

custodyProfile.uncertainty: Kempen verified the Old Mutual Wealth trust account and ZARP Standard Bank accounts, while management states that reserve funds are free of other debts, liens, and encumbrances and reserved exclusively for redemption. The materials do not establish statutory bankruptcy remoteness, rehypothecation terms, or a redemption settlement time.
